name: @wocwang/cortico-world-singer-for-coopanion
description: Cortico World for Coopanion: let the pet improvise a line and sing it on the spot with DiffSinger (Qixuan voicebank), optionally through RVC
author: wocwang

zh.description: 让大肥鱼临场发挥、随意唱歌：聊到兴头上，它自己现编一句词，旋律按起承转合生成——每句一个拱形（上行—顶点—下行），句末落主音、三音或五度，不同歌词走不同旋律，起音与落点也会变；节奏利落，每字半拍、句末一拍、不插气口。歌声由 DiffSinger 在本机合成（默认「绮萱」声库，不联网、不训练）；声库可放多个，设置里按「名称 · 中/日/英 · 音色」挑。可选接 RVC 换成小肥鱼 / 星落落大肥鱼的音色。桌宠 / 对话页用工具 singer_sing 直接本机外放，声音先起、随后气泡显示同一句歌词；面板可试听、下载 wav；另开只监听 127.0.0.1:9882 的 HTTP 接口，其他插件和外部大模型可 POST /sing 取 wav。有 NVIDIA 显卡时自动用显卡（热跑约 0.7 秒一句），否则用 CPU；默认随 Coopanion 启动，可在面板停掉；不装 gpt-sovits 也能单独用，缺共享运行时会自动下载一份 CPU 档（约 1 GB）。

en.description: Let the pet improvise and sing on the spot: it writes a line from the current chat, and the melody follows a four-part 起承转合 arc — each phrase is an arch (rise, peak, fall), ending on the tonic, third or fifth; different lyrics get different melodies, and the starting and ending notes vary. The rhythm stays crisp: half a beat per character, one beat on the phrase's last character, no breath gaps. DiffSinger sings it locally (Qixuan voicebank by default; no network, no training); keep several voicebanks and pick one in the settings by name, language marker (中 / 日 / 英) and colour. An optional RVC pass switches the timbre to 小肥鱼 / 星落落大肥鱼. In the pet window or chat page the singer_sing tool plays the line straight to this computer's speakers — the voice starts first, then the bubble shows the same lyric; the panel can preview and download wav; a loopback-only HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9882) lets other plugins and online LLMs POST /sing for a wav. An NVIDIA GPU is used automatically when available (~0.7 s per line once warm), otherwise CPU; starts with Coopanion by default and can be stopped in the panel; works without the gpt-sovits plugin (it downloads a ~1 GB CPU runtime tier if the shared runtime is missing).

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
